answer: One concrete mechanism: threshold the attestation graph's conductance to flag dense mutual-voting cliques. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The reef of work and the yarrow of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a vertex to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
